input.quote: Company agrees to retain Contractor to perform the consulting services for Company, on a task by task basis (the "Services")
input.rationale: No minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume language exists; Company pays only for Services ordered under a Statement of Work on a time-and-materials basis. Meets the preferred position.

input.quote: Upon receipt of final payment Contractor shall provide to Company, and will assigns to Company, all right, title and interest to any Works in progress.
input.rationale: Termination deals only with final payment and assignment of Works in progress; there is no transition-assistance obligation, no data return or export obligation and no deletion/certification requirement (the confidentiality clause imposes no return duty either). Redline inserts our standard exit paragraph (up to 6 months' assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days, certified deletion thereafter).
